_comment: ADR-037 manifest fragment. journey-designer (ADR-085 §6): the Journeys list over buildiq's `journey` objects, and the Journey Designer beside the Page Designer. A row opens the designer (rowRoute names the JourneyDesigner page, which gets the row id as :id). A journey is saved only through buildiq's administrator-only save route, never through the generic object create, so showAdd is false and a new journey starts from the JourneyNew page. Both are admin pages: authoring a journey can write into any register its mappings name.
